A '''permlight''' was a type of fixed lighting used to illuminate buildings, tunnels, and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Permlights were also often employed as emergency lighting and could continue functioning even when normal lighting systems were unavailable.<ref name="SQ" />

Emergency permlights were present aboard the [[Outbound Flight]] project, where their failure during a shipwide power disruption was considered highly unusual.<ref name="SQ" /> Similar lights were also used in abandoned mining tunnels, where they continued operating long after the primary [[Glow panel/Legends|glow panels]] had ceased functioning.<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>
